'''Terkar''' was an [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] who was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[Minboosa District]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Vobbara Yusinduu]].<ref name="WhatBothersMinboosa" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.5}}</ref> Terkar was freed by the [[Alliance Commander]] and former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sa'har Kateen]] during the [[rebellion in the Minboosa District]].<ref name="WhatBothersMinboosa" /> Terkar claimed that the workers moving through the [[Polluted Swamp|swamp]] of the Minboosa District were being attacked by [[xuvva]]s and asked the Commander to head into the swamp and recover scent glands to protect the workers on their travels in exchange for information about the [[Hidden Chain]] [[Hidden Chain dropship|shuttle]] in the district.<ref name="GlandHandling">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Gland Handling|[[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]]}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Terkar first appeared in the [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240502-0|text=Game Update 7.5 "Desperate Defiance" Recap and VOD}}</ref>
